mara.activity: Wake, drink water, make the bed, and gather myself before getting dressed.
mara.intention: Begin slowly and establish a clear sequence for the day.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and dress in practical clothes for a workday at home.
mara.intention: Get ready without letting the presentation pull me into work too early.

mara.activity: Have a slow breakfast and coffee at the kitchen island while Julian makes breakfast nearby; read a few pages and let the presentation sequence settle in my mind without opening the full checklist.
mara.intention: Keep breakfast restorative while allowing useful priorities to surface naturally.

mara.activity: Clear my breakfast things, rinse the mug and water glass, and make a small visual reset of the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Leave a clean working surface and avoid carrying breakfast clutter into the day.

mara.activity: Review household plans and bills at the office desk, sorting the mail and noting any payments or decisions that need attention.
mara.intention: Complete the usual household administration before the focused presentation work.

mara.activity: Eat a simple lunch at the kitchen island and pause without reopening the presentation materials.
mara.intention: Take a genuine break while the house is quieter.

mara.activity: Work through one concentrated presentation review at the office desk, checking the planting rationale, sequence, and unresolved visual details; leave the fabric samples and planting sketches together on the desk shelf when finished.
mara.intention: Make the judgments defensible and coherent without endlessly expanding the scope.

mara.activity: Take a brisk walk around the neighborhood before answering messages, letting the presentation loosen its hold for a little while.
mara.intention: Discharge the controlled pressure before returning to household and family conversation.

mara.activity: Return, put my keys on the kitchen island, drink water, and answer only the messages that genuinely require a response.
mara.intention: Re-enter the house calmly and keep communication bounded.

mara.activity: Spend a quiet hour reading and making a few loose garden notes in the living room, staying available without actively hosting.
mara.intention: Create a pleasant, low-demand interval before cooking and the evening visit.

mara.activity: Check the kitchen and guest-facing rooms, straighten only what is distracting, and set out a comfortable but restrained evening arrangement.
mara.intention: Make the house welcoming without surrendering the whole afternoon to preparation.

mara.activity: Prepare a large meal for leftovers, washing and cutting vegetables, cooking the main dish, and setting aside portions for the week before Julian's dinner service begins.
mara.intention: Follow the planned cooking rhythm and give the evening a dependable center.

mara.activity: Eat dinner with the relative and Julian, keeping conversation warm while allowing myself to listen more than manage the room.
mara.intention: Offer affection and hospitality while preserving some inner space.

mara.activity: Help clear the table and rinse the dishes, then step away from the conversation for a short private reset in the piano hall with the lights low.
mara.intention: Reduce social overstimulation before the final part of the evening.

mara.activity: Return to the living room for a bounded, easy stretch of time with the relative, keeping the conversation light and excusing myself if it becomes repetitive or emotionally loaded.
mara.intention: Be present without abandoning the privacy I need.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea, quietly straighten the kitchen, and check that the guest arrangements remain comfortable without rearranging the relative's belongings.
mara.intention: Close the shared part of the day with calm care rather than more work.

mara.activity: Wash up, change into sleep clothes, brush my teeth, and put tomorrow's clothes ready.
mara.intention: Shift decisively out of work and hosting mode.

mara.activity: Read a few pages in bed with the lights low, then put the paperback book and reading glasses on my side of the nightstand and set my phone aside.
mara.intention: Protect the quiet ending I managed yesterday and let the presentation wait until morning.
End the day before fatigue turns the deadline into rumination.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes before getting up.
julian.intention: Start slowly and avoid bringing restaurant urgency into the morning.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in lounge pants and a clean shirt.
julian.intention: Feel properly awake before joining the household.

julian.activity: Make pancakes and eggs with butter, then carry a mug and a plate to the dining table and eat with Mara and the visiting relative while keeping conversation easy.
julian.intention: Keep our usual Sunday breakfast generous but uncomplicated.

julian.activity: Carry my plate and mug to the sink, rinse them, wipe the kitchen island, and leave my restaurant notebook on the island with yesterday's receipts tucked inside.
julian.intention: Clear just enough space for the day without starting a full house reset.

julian.activity: Pack a small backpack with water, my phone, reading glasses, and a paperback book, then collect my keys from the piano's middle shelf.
julian.intention: Prepare for a long walk and lunch away from the restaurant and the house.

julian.activity: Take a long walk and have lunch away from the restaurant, letting my head settle before returning home.
julian.intention: Get real distance from work and the crowded feeling at home.

julian.activity: Return home, put the backpack down by the kitchen island, drink water, and sit quietly in the living room without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Have a protected stretch of solitude while the house is occupied.

julian.activity: Read a few pages, then check the refrigerator and make a small yogurt-and-banana snack.
julian.intention: Eat before practice so I do not become irritable or overhungry.

julian.activity: Practice piano and play through several new melodies, keeping the volume warm rather than loud.
julian.intention: Use the familiar repetition to reset my attention.

julian.activity: Stay mostly out of the kitchen while Mara prepares the large meal, then set the dining table and carry out plates, forks, table knives, and water glasses.
julian.intention: Be helpful without crowding Mara's focused work or taking over the cooking.

julian.activity: Eat dinner with Mara and our relative, then help portion the remaining food into storage bags and carry the portions to the refrigerator.
julian.intention: Share the meal generously and make the coming week easier.

julian.activity: Rinse the serving dishes, put the leftovers away, and leave the kitchen tidy enough for morning without chasing every last crumb.
julian.intention: Finish the useful work while preserving my energy.

julian.activity: Move to the living room, drop my wallet and earplugs on the coffee table, and sit quietly with a paperback book while the household winds down.
julian.intention: Take a low-demand pause after the social evening.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and change into sleep clothes.
julian.intention: Shift decisively into rest rather than extending the evening.

julian.activity: Put my phone on its charger, return the earplugs and wallet to my pockets, and get into bed beside Mara without turning on the television.
julian.intention: End the day quietly and be ready for the week.
Recover fully before Monday ordering and payroll.
